rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal heat pump behaviour, asked whether clothes dry at the end, and concluded no repair was needed, with no part recommended. It missed the chance to ask about the cold garage, door opening mid-cycle and filter cleaning, and gave no practical tips for shortening cycles (avoid opening the door, higher spin speed, warmer location). The opening 'switch it off and unplug it' is odd and unnecessary, and there was no mention of warranty contact if a real fault appears, though 'get back in touch' is a mild fallback.
